text.tspan: KRABBY M16 / TASK 3 — POWER, SENSORS / CONTROLLERS
Connection overview · matching net names are electrically connected
Motor power and MCU supply branches
Both INA boards: SHUNT open; VBUS open
Pack: A0/A1 closed · Midpoint: A0 open, A1 closed
Potentiometer supply / GND / position → MCU ADC
UART bundles: leader TX → follower RX; leader RX ← follower TX; common GND
Follower uplink: Serial1 or Serial2 as detected by firmware. All controllers share PACK− reference.
Sense leads require suitable branch protection at the battery taps. Do not apply pack voltage to MCU or Qwiic power pins.
